Suggest one museum to visit in Madrid.

The Museo del Prado is the one to pick. It houses masterpieces by Velázquez, Goya, and El Greco, including Velázquez's *Las Meninas*. Book tickets ahead and go early or in the evening to avoid the biggest crowds.
